description: This file defines an Android activity class named Grid1 that displays a grid of app icons representing launchable applications on the device. It loads apps using an intent filter, populates a GridView with icons through a custom adapter, and manages view recycling.

classes.name: Grid1
classes.description: An Android Activity that displays a grid of app icons representing launcher activities available on the device. Implements methods for loading apps and populating the grid.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, loads app data, sets the content view, and attaches the adapter to the GridView.

methods.name: loadApps
methods.description: Creates an intent to query all main launcher activities and stores the result in mApps list.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getView
methods.description: Provides a view for each item in the app list, creating or recycling ImageView objects and setting icon drawables.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of apps available.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Returns the ResolveInfo object at the specified position.

methods.name: AppsAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns the item ID, here simply the position.
